archetype: palisaded caravan trade outpost with market, lodging and stocked paddocks

orientation.market_stalls: west and east of the central service spine

settlement_program: octagonal full-log palisade with a five-wide wagon gate and overhead guard bridge
two furnished guard towers with bell, map station, stores and defensive cache
internal perimeter path, cross-market lane and north-south service spine
four inward-facing canvas stalls for provisions, medicine, repair goods and livestock supplies
central trade lodge with public hall, records office, secure stores and workshop
resident bunkhouse with sleeping, mess and supply functions
working stone well, refuse point and service storage
two independently gated full-log paddocks with feed, water and mixed livestock
circulation: road through the guarded wagon gate to the market cross-lane
market lane connects all four stalls and the central lodge entrance
lodge public hall connects controlled rear rooms and rear service exit
service spine joins lodge, well, bunkhouse and both paddock gates
internal ring path provides a secondary route around the whole settlement
damage_constraints: confine the primary palisade breach to the east-southeast perimeter
confine secondary canopy failure to the southeast market stall
preserve the main gate, lodge, bunkhouse, well and both animal enclosures
preserve all declared settlement routes and mixed livestock
derive the inhabited ruin from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the palisade and gatehouse read as a coherent defensible settlement
each market stall communicates a distinct trade purpose
lodge, guard and bunkhouse interiors work at player scale
both paddocks contain animals after template placement
the damaged stall and perimeter breach preserve the intended circulation
terrain feathering seats the road, palisade and paddock edges naturally
